short_scenes.caption: 300,000 years ago…
short_scenes.narration: Three hundred thousand years ago, on the African grasslands, lived a young hunter named John. Strong. Fearless. And completely alone.

short_scenes.caption: Then he saw her.
short_scenes.narration: One morning, at the river, he saw her. Mia. A girl from another tribe, laughing as she caught fish with her bare hands.

short_scenes.caption: Their eyes met.
short_scenes.narration: Their eyes met. John forgot how to breathe. Mia smiled, just for a second.

short_scenes.caption: The grass moved…
short_scenes.narration: But behind him, the tall grass moved. Slowly. Silently.

short_scenes.caption: Who is in the grass? Comment your guess!
short_scenes.narration: Who is in the grass? Comment your guess below. Follow so you don't miss the next part.
